No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. Suddenly, she spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. She reaches out a hand, and Finley is sucked into her grasp.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley struggles and squirms in Jen's hand, but she holds tight. Jen pulls Finley out of the water and onto the beach, where Finley lies flailing on the sand.

JEN
(curiously)
What's wrong, little guy? You're not used to being out of the water, are you?

Finley looks up at Jen with a mixture of fear and confusion. Jen holds him up to the sky, and Finley's gaze follows the sun as it begins to darken.

JEN
(amused)
Oh, look! A solar eclipse! Isn't it amazing?

Finley's eyes widen in terror as the sun's corona appears, casting an otherworldly glow over the beach. Finley's body begins to convulse, and he speaks in a voice that is both familiar and yet, utterly alien.

FINLEY
(whispering)
The void... it's coming... the void is coming...

JEN
(confused)
What's wrong, Finley? You're not making any sense.

FINLEY
(urgently)
You don't understand... the horrors beyond your comprehension... the eldritch abominations that lurk beyond the veil of reality... they're coming for us all...

Jen's expression changes from amusement to concern as Finley's monologue grows more frantic.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I see them... I see the twisted, cyclopean cities... the screaming, tentacled creatures... the infinite, abyssal void that awaits us all...

Jen's grip on Finley tightens, but Finley's body begins to contort and twist, as if he's being pulled apart by some unseen force.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I am but a mere mortal... a fleeting, insignificant speck in the grand tapestry of existence... and yet... and yet... I am aware... I am aware of the crushing weight of the unknown...

Jen's eyes widen in horror as Finley's monologue reaches a fever pitch.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I am but a fish... a mere fish... and yet... I am the universe... I am the cosmos... I am the abyss...

Finley's body goes limp, and he stares blankly at the sky, his eyes fixed on the solar eclipse. Jen looks on, unsure of what to do.

JEN
(whispering)
Finley... Finley, are you okay?

Finley's gaze remains fixed on the eclipse, his expression a mixture of terror and awe.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I am not okay... I am not okay... I am but a mere mortal... a fleeting, insignificant speck in the grand tapestry of existence...

The camera zooms out as the solar eclipse reaches its peak, casting a dark, otherworldly shadow over the beach. Finley's monologue fades into the distance, replaced by an eerie, unsettling silence.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen is still holding Finley, but his body is limp and lifeless. She looks on, unsure of what to do.

JEN
(whispering)
Finley... Finley, wake up...

Finley's eyes flicker open, and he stares blankly at Jen. For a moment, it seems as though he's returned to normal.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I... I don't know... I don't know what's happening...

Jen looks on, unsure of what to do.

JEN
(gently)
It's okay, Finley. You're safe now.

Finley's gaze remains fixed on Jen, and for a moment, it seems as though he's trying to communicate with her.

FINLEY
(whispering)
But... but the void... it's still there... it's still waiting...

Jen's expression changes from concern to fear as Finley's words hang in the air.

JEN
(whispering)
Finley... what do you mean?

Finley's gaze remains fixed on Jen, and for a moment, it seems as though he's trying to warn her of something.

FINLEY
(whispering)
The void... it's coming... and when it does... we'll all be consumed...

The camera zooms out as Finley's words fade into the distance, replaced by an eerie, unsettling silence.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - LATER

Jen is still holding Finley, but his body is limp and lifeless. She looks on, unsure of what to do.

JEN
(whispering)
Finley... Finley, wake up...

The camera zooms out as the sun begins to set, casting a golden glow over the beach. Finley's body remains still, his eyes fixed on the horizon.

FADE TO BLACK.

THE END.
